newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 6.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 6.

text.p: These were the main headlines reported by Kuku Radio on Thursday at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- Information on the financial situtaion of parliamentarians and members of the government was published today.
- Parliament members will personally fund the construction of a freedom memorial in Tallinn.
